content.text:
The grey descriptive text on the home page is now `#3d4650`. I added the rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css`, scoped to `.page-home`, so no other page changes.

It covers the hero subtitle (`.lede`) and the paragraphs inside cards. That means the Aurora Lamp blurb, the three "Why Acme" perks, the newsletter text and its "We never share your address" note. I checked the computed colour in a browser and all of those now read `rgb(61, 70, 80)`.

- **Not changed:** the three stat captions ("orders shipped this year" and the other two) and the footer are still the old grey `#59636e`. They aren't under headings, so I left them. If you want them darker too, it's one more selector.
- **Tests:** the functional tests pass (12 of 12). The visual tests also pass, but the approved screenshots weren't updated. The new colour is close enough to the old one that the default screenshot tolerance doesn't flag it, so those tests don't confirm this change.

STATUS: DONE
